detail: ANCOVA Scores ~ Method + Income (real-statistics.com); Method is a 3-level between-subjects treatment, one row per subject, no repeated/clustering.
One-way ANOVA pain threshold ~ hair colour (McClave & Dietrich 1991); Subject is a unique row id, Hair color a between factor, no repeated measures.
Two-way ANOVA Yield ~ Blend * Crop (real-statistics.com); Ss is a unique subject id, between-subjects design, no grouping factor.
Two-way ANOVA Scores ~ Diet * Exercise; Ss is a unique subject id, between-subjects, no grouping factor.
Three-way between-subjects ANOVA Cholesterol ~ Sex * Risk * Drug; no subject/cluster column, no repeated measures.
Three-way between-subjects ANOVA (unbalanced) Cholesterol ~ Sex * Risk * Drug; no subject/cluster column, no repeated measures.
Bland-Altman method-agreement data, two measurement columns A and B (wide), 30 rows; no grouping factor.
UCI heart-disease data for a chi-square independence test; one row per patient, no grouping factor.
McNemar paired-binary data (treatment_X, treatment_Y) in wide form, one row per subject; no grouping column.
Circular statistics: orientation tuning of three neurons as wide columns (N1Spikes/N2Spikes/N3Spikes), 8 orientations; no grouping factor.
Wide (Q1..Q11) binary questionnaire with missing values; the grouping (subject) is the row and items are columns, no grouping column.
pingouin's dataset catalogue (dataset, description, useful, ref); metadata, not observations.
Mediation-analysis regression data (X, M, Y, W1, W2, ...); one row per observation, no grouping factor.
MANOVA / multivariate-normality example (Fever, Pressure, Aches by Condition); Condition is a 2-level between treatment (predictor of interest), one row per subject, no clustering.
Palmer penguins; used in pingouin for fixed-effects regression/ANOVA/correlation; species and island are few-level predictors, not sampled clusters.
Restaurant tips (one waiter, one restaurant); used for regression; day/time are few-level predictors, no repeated-measures clustering.
Monthly airline passengers (Prophet time-series example); a single time series, no replication.
BART categorical classification of hawk Species from body measurements; one row per bird, Species is the response not a grouping factor.
Height/weight/sex, 70 rows; no documenting .myst.md notebook; one row per person, no grouping factor.
Liddell & Kruschke IMDB ratings as wide per-movie counts (n1..n5), one row per movie; the ordinal model (rating within movie) needs the long reshape, no grouping column in the loaded wide table.
Log-Gaussian Cox process (spatial point pattern) of anemone locations (x, y, marks); a point process, no grouping factor.
Length by month-of-age (data_container demo); a cross-sectional regression (different babies per month), no repeated-measures id, no grouping factor.
BART regression of hourly bike counts on weather; no random effect over a grouping column.
Body-fat regression / model-averaging example; one row per person, no grouping factor.
Cherry-blossom day-of-year and temperature by year (spline example); a single annual time series, no replication.
Swiss MHB site-occupancy data in wide form (detection history det<yr><visit> and date columns per quadrat), one row per quadrat; survey-level observations are columns, no grouping column.
County-level uranium (Uppm) covariate table merged into the radon model; one row per county, no within-county replication, no observation response.
Monthly deaths and temperature (excess-deaths causal example); a single interrupted time series, no replication.
Efron-Morris 1975 baseball partial-pooling example; one binomial observation (Hits out of At-Bats) per player, so no grouping column has two or more observations in a level.
The GLM-ordinal-regression notebook generates this as fake data (np.random; latent_rating simulated then discretised into explicit_rating).
Multi-output (coregionalized) Gaussian process over pitchers' spin rate by game date; a GP model (and a top-5-pitchers subset), not a grouping random effect.

Gambia malaria geostatistical example; the notebook aggregates to 65 villages by coordinates (x, y) and fits a spatial Gaussian process on prevalence. The only candidate grouping is the coordinate pair and the model is a GP, so no grouping factor per the coordinate/GP rules.
Hierarchical Bayesian VAR (vector autoregression) over countries; a multivariate time-series model with lagged dependence, observations not exchangeable within a country.

California heating-system choice in wide form (costs per alternative as columns, one row per household); conditional-logit over alternatives-as-columns, no grouping column (the long reshape long_heating_data is filed instead).
Advertising spend vs sales regression (BART heteroscedasticity example); one row per market period, no grouping factor.
Breast-cancer survival (Cox PH on metastasized); one row per patient, no cluster/frailty grouping.
MEPS health-expenditure causal-inference example (propensity/BART); one row per individual, region is a few-level covariate, no grouping random effect.
Moderation analysis muscle% ~ training x age (interaction); one row per person (id), fixed-effects regression, no grouping factor.
NHEFS smoking-cessation causal-inference example (propensity/BART); one row per individual, no grouping random effect.
Adjacency edge list (node1, node2) for the NYC BYM spatial model; graph structure, not an observation table.
NYC pedestrian-accident BYM areal model; one row per census tract, the spatial/unstructured random effects are observation-level (one per tract), no grouping with replication.
Old Faithful eruptions/waiting (Dirichlet-process mixture / density estimation); unsupervised, no grouping factor.
Scotland lip-cancer CAR spatial model; 56 areas with one observation each, the spatial random effect is observation-level (one per area), no grouping with replication.
Confirmatory-factor / SEM survey indicators (wide, one row per individual); a latent-factor measurement model, indicators are columns, no grouping factor with replication.
Annual sunspot series (Dirichlet-process mixture example); a single time series, no replication (and a malformed header read as data).
Prediction grid of Swiss 1km cells (coordinates + elevation/forest/water) for mapping occupancy; no response, no grouping, one row per cell.
Student test-score regression data; no documenting .myst.md notebook; no school/class id column, no grouping factor.
Daily COVID hospitalisation counts at one hospital; a single time series, no replication.
Gelman arsenic-wells logistic-regression data (switch ~ arsenic + dist + ...); no documenting .myst.md notebook; one row per household, no grouping factor.
